note: All cited PDFs were ALREADY banked in TanitAD Research Lab/Library/papers; nothing new was downloaded. sha256 below is of the library file on G: (read-only) and is compared against library.json when it records one. Four DiffusionDrive v1 code files (hustvl/DiffusionDrive main HEAD 9b52ed0ec06b073d82d6f392ab084c7b301c8681 at retrieval) are copied to code_DiffusionDrive_9b52ed0/ as PUBLISHED-CODE evidence for the Master Mind to bank if wanted.

papers.title: DiffusionDrive: Truncated Diffusion Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.one_line_finding: DiffusionDrive v1: map = Transfuser 7-class BEV semantic aux head (i) + trajectory-coordinate spatial cross-attn into BEV features (ii); NAVSIM has no vectorized map so only agent cross-attn; Table 3 ID2->ID3 DAC 83.2->95.4.

papers.title: DiffusionDriveV2: Reinforcement Learning-Constrained Truncated Diffusion Modeling in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.one_line_finding: DiffusionDriveV2: selector samples BEV at trajectory coords then cross-attends agent+map queries, BCE+margin-rank on PDM sub-scores (iv); Table 9 DD v1 + this selector DAC 96.2->97.0.

papers.title: TransFuser: Imitation with Transformer-Based Sensor Fusion for Autonomous Driving
papers.one_line_finding: TransFuser PAMI: HD-map aux head (road/lane marking/other, 64x64) is aux-only (i); Table 7 No-HD-Map DS 50.96 vs all-losses 56.68 best / 49.49 worst seed.

papers.title: NAVSIM: Data-Driven Non-Reactive Autonomous Vehicle Simulation and Benchmarking
papers.one_line_finding: NAVSIM: DAC is a x0 hard penalty; Table 2 E1 'No BEV segmentation' DAC 90.5 / PDMS 81.6 vs default seeds 83.3-84.4 (std 0.56).

papers.title: VAD: Vectorized Scene Representation for Efficient Autonomous Driving
papers.one_line_finding: VAD: vectorized map; ego-map cross-attn (ii) + ego-boundary hinge (delta_bd=1.0 m, Eq.5) + lane-direction constraint (delta_dir=2.0 m, Eq.6) at training (iii); Table 2 ID7 vs ID1 L2 0.72 vs 0.86.

papers.title: VADv2: End-to-End Vectorized Autonomous Driving via Probabilistic Planning
papers.one_line_finding: VADv2: map tokens (ii) + conflict loss that treats vocabulary actions conflicting with road boundaries as negatives (iii/Eq.6); Table 7 no-map-token L2@3s 0.332 vs 0.290.

papers.title: SparseDrive: End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Sparse Scene Representation
papers.one_line_finding: SparseDrive: agent-map cross-attention (ii) over vectorized map instances; collision-aware rescore is agent-only; map-cross-attn NOT ablated in Table 4.

papers.title: Hydra-MDP: End-to-end Multimodal Planning with Multi-target Hydra-Distillation
papers.one_line_finding: Hydra-MDP: BCE-distilled per-candidate sub-score heads incl. DAC from simulator labels (map-derived) (iv); Eq.11 weighted selection; Table 1 V8192 DAC 91.7 -> -W 96.1.

papers.title: Hydra-MDP++: Advancing End-to-End Driving via Expert-Guided Hydra-Distillation
papers.one_line_finding: Hydra-MDP++: Table 3 W off/on DAC 92.0->96.0 (PDMS 85.0->86.5), aux perception P hurts (86.6->86.1); Table 5 LK teacher raises LK 65.5->67.2 (R34).

papers.title: DriveSuprim: Towards Precise Trajectory Selection for End-to-End Planning
papers.one_line_finding: DriveSuprim: coarse-to-fine scorer with BCE on sim sub-score labels; Table 1 oracle top-16 DAC 99.8, top-1 91.9 PDMS.

papers.title: GoalFlow: Goal-Driven Flow Matching for Multimodal Trajectories Generation in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.one_line_finding: GoalFlow: goal-point scorer with DAC head (shadow-vehicle corners in drivable polygon, Eq.16 BCE w5=0.005); Table 2 M1->M2 DAC 96.4->97.5, ->M3 98.3.

papers.title: End-to-End Driving with Online Trajectory Evaluation via BEV World Model
papers.one_line_finding: WoTE: 7-class BEV semantic supervision of predicted future BEV states + sim-reward (DAC) scorer; Table 4 sim-reward-only DAC 94.7 vs imitation-only 92.5.

papers.title: Generalized Trajectory Scoring for End-to-end Multimodal Planning
papers.one_line_finding: GTRS: Transfuser-style BEV segmentation aux head on the DP generator (i); scorer trained on sim sub-scores, map not an input.

papers.title: Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop End-to-End Autonomous Driving?
papers.one_line_finding: BEV-Planner: Curb Collision Rate (CCR, raster boundary at 0.1 m); Table 3 map aux task CCR 4.26->2.60 but L2 0.55->0.96.

papers.title: Parting with Misconceptions about Learning-based Vehicle Motion Planning
papers.one_line_finding: PDM: rule-based PDM-Closed = IDM proposals (5 speeds x 3 centerline offsets) scored by sim; CLS 92-93 vs learned 50-72.

papers.title: Pseudo-Simulation for Autonomous Driving
papers.one_line_finding: NAVSIM v2 pseudo-simulation: EPDMS penalties NC/DAC/DDC/TLC, LK weight 2, filter_m ignores violations the human also commits.
